title: Stabili-Teeth®: Rethinking Full-Arch Implant Dentistry
html:
In this sponsored interview, Dr. Paul Feuerstein, Editor-in-Chief of Dentistry Today, speaks with Bari Medgaus, Co-Founder, President & CMO of Stabili-Teeth®, and Dr. Dale Spadafora, DMD, MAGD, Chief Clinical Officer and Lead Educator at Stabili-Teeth®, about the Stabili-Teeth® treatment protocol and its approach to fixed full-arch implant dentistry.

The conversation explores the clinical approach behind Stabili-Teeth®, including implant placement, prosthetic components, treatment planning, and considerations for making full-arch treatment more accessible. The discussion also covers practice implementation, clinical education, patient communication, and the resources available to support participating dental practices.

FEATURING:

  • Bari Medgaus — Co-Founder, President & CMO, Stabili-Teeth®
  • Dr. Dale Spadafora, DMD, MAGD — Chief Clinical Officer and Lead Educator, Stabili-Teeth®
  • HOST: Dr. Paul Feuerstein, Editor-in-Chief of Dentistry Today

Sponsored by Stabili-Teeth®
